faq.q: How far is Puerto Banús from the Ironman 2031 finish line?
faq.a: Puerto Banús is roughly 1.5 km from the Marbella promenade finish area — a 15-minute walk or 5-minute taxi ride. Most charter boats dock at the port's main quay, making it a seamless post-race transition.

faq.q: Can I charter a boat for just 2 hours after Ironman?
faq.a: Yes. Our Tier A boats (Astondoa 40, Azimut 39) start at €749 for 2 hours, including skipper, fuel, drinks, and snacks. Perfect for a quick sunset cruise to calm tired legs before dinner.

faq.q: What's the best boat for a small recovery group of 4–6 people?
faq.a: The Bandido (11.5m, 8 pax) or the Pershing 46 (14m, 10 pax) offer ample deck space and shaded seating. Both depart from Puerto Banús and include all standard amenities. Pricing is on request via WhatsApp.

faq.q: Are there any boats with a jet ski included for post-race fun?
faq.a: Yes — the Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) includes a free jet ski in its 4-hour charter package (€4,719). It's a great way for non-racing friends to enjoy the water while you recover on deck.

faq.q: Can I book a half-day charter (4 hours) for recovery?
faq.a: Absolutely. Most boats offer 4-hour charters. The Azimut 58 Flybridge (17.6m, 12 pax) is ideal for a longer cruise to Cabopino or Cala del Faro, with plenty of shade and a swim step for gentle dips.

faq.q: What's included in the charter that helps with recovery?
faq.a: All charters include water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, and light snacks. The boat's cooler keeps hydration close. You also get a licensed skipper, so you can fully relax without any responsibility.

faq.q: Can I bring my own recovery food or supplements on board?
faq.a: Yes, you're welcome to bring your own food and supplements. The galley has a fridge and storage. Just let us know in advance so we can ensure proper stowage. Standard snacks are provided unless you opt for catering.

faq.q: How do I book for Ironman 2031 weekend?
faq.a: Contact us via WhatsApp for availability and pricing on specific boats. We recommend booking at least 2–4 weeks ahead, as Marbella fills up during Ironman. Provide your preferred date, group size, and charter duration.

data.body_html:
Crossing the Ironman 2031 finish line in Marbella is a monumental achievement. Your muscles have earned a break. A Marbella yacht charter for Ironman 2031 recovery day lets you float the fatigue away on the Mediterranean — with cold drinks, a shaded deck, and zero planning. Depart from Puerto Banús, just minutes from the finish area, and let a licensed skipper steer while you stretch, hydrate, and relive the race.

Why a recovery yacht charter works post-Ironman

Active recovery — gentle movement, hydration, and elevation of legs — reduces muscle soreness faster than sitting still. On a private charter, you can alternate between lounging on a padded sunpad, taking a buoyant dip in calm coves, and sipping electrolyte-rich water from the onboard cooler. The gentle roll of the boat at anchor provides a natural massage for tired calves and quads.

Our fleet for Ironman recovery groups

We offer 18 boats from Puerto Banús, all with licensed skippers, fuel, insurance, and drinks (water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava) plus light snacks — all included in the price. For small groups of 4–5, the Dubhe (8m, 5 pax) or Mariah SX21 (6.4m, 5 pax) are compact and cost-effective. For 8–10 people, the Bandido (11.5m, 8 pax) or Fairline Targa 12m (10 pax) offer more deck space. Larger parties of 12 can book the Azimut 58 Flybridge (17.6m) or the Ferretti 94 (29m) for ultimate luxury.

Pricing for Ironman 2031 charters

Our Tier A boats — Astondoa 40 and Azimut 39 — start at €749 for 2 hours (all inclusive) and go up to €2,299 for 8 hours. For a premium experience, the Mangusta 80 (white or grey) costs €4,719 for a minimum 4 hours and includes a free jet ski. All other boats are priced on request via WhatsApp — simply tell us your group size and preferred duration.

Best recovery routes from Puerto Banús

A short 30-minute cruise east takes you to Cala del Faro, a sheltered cove with calm, clear water perfect for a gentle swim. Heading west, Cala Cortés offers a quiet anchorage with views of La Concha mountain. For a longer trip, sail to Cabopino (45 min) or Estepona (1 hour). Each route allows you to anchor, dip, and hydrate without crowds.

What to bring for your recovery day

Pack compression gear, a towel, sunscreen, and any personal recovery snacks or supplements. The boat provides a cooler with ice, so bring electrolyte powders or protein shakes. You can also request a gourmet catering upgrade (e.g., sushi, fresh fruit platters) via WhatsApp when booking. Leave the logistics to us — the skipper handles navigation, anchoring, and safety.

Book your Ironman 2031 recovery charter

To secure your preferred boat and time slot, contact us on WhatsApp with your group size and ideal date. Early booking (2–4 weeks ahead) is recommended as Marbella is busy during Ironman weekend. For more details on our full fleet and services, visit our Marbella yacht charter homepage.
